Morgan (PM): Quick async check — QTR milestone tidy. Please drop one line each: what shipped, what slipped, current owner for next action, and any hard deps we need to escalate. Trying to close the OKR board by EOW.

Ben (Eng): Shipped: routing v2 canary + perf baseline. Slipped: dedupe cache work by 2 weeks (blocked on infra kernel patch). Owner: Ben. Dep: infra kernel patch from Ciara.

Ciara (Infra): Kernel patch queued with vendor, ETA ~1 week. Can fast-track if we escalate to enterprise support — @morgan do you want me to open the ticket?

Morgan (PM): Yes please open enterprise ticket. Marking as high priority; we need dedupe to land for QTR metric.

Zoe (QA): Test plan for routing v2 done, running soak. Found one regression (tokenization edge case) — low severity. Owner: Zoe to triage with Ben.

Ben (Eng): Noted — I'll pair with Zoe tomorrow for the tokenization fix.

Rahul (Platform): Dedicated capacity rollout: shipped initial autoscaler rules. Slipped: model pinning UI (UX needs sign-off) — @morgan need your final ok or we ship with minimal UI and iterate. Owner: Rahul.

Maya (SRE): Observability: added per-route latency panels. We still need cost breakdown per-model (blocked on billing schema). Owner: Maya. Dep: finance schema change from @finance (cc @sarah-finance).

deploy-bot: Deploy: routing-v2-canary -> prod (paused) — waiting on QA signoff.

Morgan (PM): Action items summarised:
```
- Ben: fix tokenization + coordinate with Zoe (ETA 24h)
- Ciara: escalate kernel patch with enterprise ticket (ETA 1d)
- Rahul: decide UI minimal vs full (reply here)
- Maya: follow up with finance for billing schema (put on next sync)
```

Morgan (PM): If anyone needs a short sync I can block 15m tomorrow. Otherwise reply here with one-line status updates and ETA. :thumbsup:
